methodology.measurement: Physical lines including comments/blank lines. Explicit inline test blocks are separated lexically; this is not AST semantic LOC or equivalent-feature productivity.
methodology.inline_tests: Zig test blocks; Rust cfg(test) modules and test/tokio::test functions. Helpers outside those blocks remain conservatively in implementation.
methodology.scope: rust/main plus separately visible Rust Sealevel local dependencies; Zig source, native helpers, tooling and independent references. Not every Rust workspace utility is agent runtime code.
methodology.generated: Generated/header-marked source is tagged; target/cache/output directories are pruned before walking. Generated compilation output is not claimed absent from Rust dependency cost.
methodology.dependencies: Cargo.lock counts are locked entries across targets/features, not target-specific runtime graph counts. No zero-dependency claim: Zig uses native C/C++ and optional Rust SDK/regex/proving FFI. dlopen libraries are not shown by otool/ldd.
methodology.binaries: Existing artifact identities only. Matching current source or cold build provenance is not inferred.

native_runtime_boundaries: optional Aleo crypto SDK cdylib and Aleo VM/proving worker plus parameters
